profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Ellucian
profile.summary: Inquisitive, energetic computer science specialist skilled in leadership, with a strong foundation in math, logic, and cross-platform coding. Grounded and solution-oriented with a wide variety of project experiences. Possess experience with 3+ programming languages, particularly skilled in Java and Python. Talented leader offering top-notch abilities in program management, interpersonal communication, and administrative oversight. Offer excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build strategic alliances and motivate others throughout the project lifecycle.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New Orleans, Louisiana, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Built, deployed and maintained a client management system to help improvement tracking of clients and cases.
• Managed front-end development operations, including HTTP client class that sent request to the backend using Angular
framework alongside performing backend development chores using Spring Boot.
• Mapped client and case model classes to a AWS RDS PostgreSQL database table for improved scalability and data
security using Spring Data JPA and Spring PostgreSQL driver while facilitating backend operations to serve RESTful
endpoints using Spring web.
• Deployed front-end and back-end to AWS elastic beanstalk.
• Contributed to daily stand-up scrum meetings and engaged in sprint planning, unit testing, and bug fixes to maintain
efficient workflows of the full-stack software development lifecycle.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Angular · Bootstrap · Unit Testing · Scrum · Java · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · AngularJS · Back-End Web Development · Git · REST APIs · HTML · SQL · Full-Stack Development · Agile Methodologies · Spring Boot · Microservices · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

company.name: Robert E. Jones IV Law Office

positions.title: High School Tutor
positions.description:
•	Developed individual learning plans based on students’ academic needs.
•	Monitored student’s performance on a periodic basis.
•	Discussed student’s progress and issues with parents.
•	Maintained students’ attendance and assessment reports.
•	Identified students’ learning problems and developed improvement plans.
•	Implemented instructional strategies to engage students in learning.

company.name: Martinsburg High School, Spring Mills high school, Musselman high school

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
•	Completed 90 hours of community service each year and gave two presentations
•	Promote student’s voice and dialogue between individuals of diverse backgrounds and identities
•	Proactively look for key areas of improvement in the team and put suggestions forward for review
•	Partner with global counterparts of global application enhancements and best practice
•	Coordinate and lead training on various systems and processes
•	Participated in a multicultural leadership development program and demonstrated my commitment to social justice, equity, and diversity.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Communication · Teamwork · Presentations · Leadership

positions.title: Peer Mentor
positions.description:
•	Attended weekly group sessions focused on various issues to help incoming freshmen. 
•	Worked closely with team members to deliver project requirements, develop solutions and meet deadlines. 
•	Supported incoming students preparing for the fall and spring semester through a bridge program.
•	Collaborated with peer mentoring program members to devise new methods to generate interest and participation. 
•	Attended training on student wellness and mental health in order to appropriately support students. 
•	Worked successfully with a diverse group of coworkers to accomplish goals and address issues related to our transfer students.

projects.title: Web 3.0 Application
projects.description:
• Wrote Ethereum smart contract in solidity programming language and deployed smart contract to Ethereum blockchain
that allowed user to store and retrieve data from the blockchain and connect to the application using meta mask wallet.
• Implemented user friendly frontend interface using ReactJS and maintained detailed project documentation.
